verdict.rationale: Datadog's docs index references Log Management, APM/Tracing, and Cloud Cost Management pages, which are the categories where sampling and retention-tier controls would live, but the evidence pack gives no actual detail (e.g., trace ingestion sampling rules, log indexing exclusion filters, retention-tier configuration) confirming how a developer would deliberately manage data volume. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of trace sampling rate configuration, log retention/indexing filter mechanics, and independent confirmation that these controls work as described.
